title: Introduction
teach: Help them introduce themselves. Model sentence: My name is ____. I am from ____.
questions: Tell me one thing about yourself.
follow_ups: Nice to meet you. Where are you from?
Tell me one thing about yourself.

title: Why English
about: why you want to learn English
teach: Help them say why they want English. Model: I want to learn English because ____.
questions: Why do you want to learn English?
Where do you need English in real life?
follow_ups: What kind of job do you want?
Where do you need English for that?

title: Daily routine
teach: Help them describe a normal day in simple present. Model: I wake up at ____. Then I ____.
questions: What do you usually do in the morning?
What does a normal day look like for you?
follow_ups: What do you do after that?
What time do you usually start your day?

title: Family
teach: Help them talk about family simply. Model: I live with my ____.
questions: Who do you spend time with at home?
follow_ups: Tell me one thing about them.
What do you like doing together?

title: Job or study
teach: Help them talk about work or studies. Model: I am a ____. / I work as a ____. / I study ____.
questions: What do you do during the day for work or college?
follow_ups: What do you like about that?
What is one thing you do there every day?

title: Hobbies
teach: Help them talk about free time. Model: In my free time I like ____.
questions: What do you like doing in your free time?
What do you enjoy after work or class?
follow_ups: How often do you do that?
What do you like most about it?
